mapper.select: SELECT application_id AS applicationId, member_id AS memberId, class_id AS classId, status, applied_at AS appliedAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, rejected_at AS rejectedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM class_application WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND class_id = #{classId}

SELECT application_id AS applicationId, member_id AS memberId, class_id AS classId, status, applied_at AS appliedAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, rejected_at AS rejectedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM class_application WHERE class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY applied_at DESC

SELECT ca.application_id AS applicationId, ca.member_id AS memberId, ca.class_id AS classId, ca.status AS applicationStatus, ca.applied_at AS appliedAt, ca.approved_at AS approvedAt, ca.rejected_at AS rejectedAt, ca.completed_at AS completedAt, ca.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt,
cp.title AS title, cp.price AS price, cp.capacity AS capacity, cp.class_date AS classDate, cp.deadline AS deadline, cp.location AS location, cp.status AS classStatus
FROM class_application ca
INNER JOIN class_post cp ON ca.class_id = cp.class_id
WHERE ca.member_id = #{memberId}
ORDER BY ca.applied_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE class_application SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE class_application SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE class_application SET status = 'REJECTED', rejected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE class_application SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT application_id AS applicationId, member_id AS memberId, class_id AS classId, status, applied_at AS appliedAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, rejected_at AS rejectedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM class_application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_application WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_application WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED')

UPDATE class_application SET status = 'CANCELLED'
WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
